name: split-digits
description:
A separator between digits and the text glued to them: «iphone13pro» → «iphone 13 pro». Digits and text already apart stay as they are; a size N×M (the x latin or cyrillic, in any case) stays whole («диван140х200» → «диван 140х200»).

sep: the separator; with "|" «a1b22» → «a|1|b|22».

The step rewrites the working column; with --as NAME it writes the result to a new column NAME.

Example: semkit read core.csv split-digits write out.csv

options.name: --as
options.description: Write the result to a new column NAME and keep the working column as it is.
